cloud.title: Connect to Turzi Cloud
cloud.description: Paste the enrollment key generated in the Turzi Community Manager. The bridge will be provisioned automatically.

data_description.enrollment_key: Single-use installation key (TRZ-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX) generated in the Turzi Community Manager.
data_description.api_base_url: Only change this when connecting to a self-hosted Turzi backend.

manual.title: MQTT Broker Configuration
manual.description: Configure the connection to your own MQTT broker (self-hosted / local mode).

data_description.broker: The hostname or IP address of your MQTT broker.
data_description.port: The port number of your MQTT broker (default: 1883).
data_description.house_id: A unique identifier for this house (used in MQTT topic prefixes).
data_description.use_tls: Enable TLS encryption for the MQTT connection.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure MQTT Broker
reconfigure.description: Update the MQTT broker connection settings.

data_description.broker: The hostname or IP address of your MQTT broker.
data_description.port: The port number of your MQTT broker (default: 1883).
data_description.house_id: A unique identifier for this house (used in MQTT topic prefixes).
data_description.use_tls: Enable TLS encryption for the MQTT connection.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Turzi Cloud
reauth_confirm.description: This bridge was unlinked from the platform. Enter a new installation key to reconnect — your included domains, exposed entities and privacy blocklist are preserved.

reconfigure_cloud.title: Re-provision Turzi Cloud connection
reconfigure_cloud.description: This bridge is provisioned by Turzi Cloud, so its broker settings are not edited by hand. Enter a new installation key to re-provision it — your included domains, exposed entities and privacy blocklist are preserved.

data_description.enrollment_key: Single-use installation key (TRZ-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX) generated in the Turzi Community Manager. Submitting it revokes this bridge's current connection, so only use a key you mean to spend.
data_description.api_base_url: Only change this when connecting to a self-hosted Turzi backend.

settings.title: Options
settings.description: The bridge starts with {filters} domain filters: the devices a building controls, plus door and safety binary sensors. They publish {published} entities. Filters and exclusions are rows on the bridge's page afterwards, each with its own edit and delete.

data_description.auto_add_new: On: a new entity that matches a domain filter is published by itself. Off: domain filters cover only the entities that exist when they are saved; a new one waits until you save again.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Please check your settings and network.
error.token_invalid: This enrollment key is unknown, expired, or already used. Generate a new one in the Turzi Community Manager.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
error.home_not_ready: This home is not ready for enrollment yet — ask your community manager to configure its smart home connection.
error.broker_not_configured: The community's MQTT broker has no dynsec admin credential loaded, so no per-home credential can be minted. Load it for that broker in the Admin Panel (Brokers MQTT) and try again.
error.community_has_no_smart_home_connection: This community has no MQTT broker assigned yet. Assign one in the Admin Panel, then try again.
error.invalid_request: The server rejected the request. Check that the installation key was pasted whole.
error.api_url_invalid: No Turzi API answered at that address. Check the API base URL — it must include the /api/v2 path.

abort.already_configured: This house ID is already configured.
abort.house_already_configured: That installation key belongs to a house another turzi Bridge entry already holds, so this entry was left untouched. The key has been used up, and enrolling it revoked that other entry's connection — get a new key and use it there.

token_revoked.title: Turzi Cloud connection revoked
token_revoked.description: This bridge was unlinked from Turzi Cloud. Ask your community manager for a new enrollment key, then reconnect the integration.

unlinked.title: Bridge unlinked from Turzi
unlinked.description: The Turzi platform unlinked this bridge. Reconnect it with a new installation key (Settings → Devices & Services → turzi Bridge → Reconfigure), or remove the integration.

init.title: Options
init.description: With the current filters and exclusions, {published} entities are published and {held} are held back by an exclusion. Filters and exclusions are rows on the bridge's page.

data_description.auto_add_new: On: a new entity that matches a domain filter is published by itself. Off: domain filters cover only the entities that exist when you save here; a new one waits until you save again.

user.title: Add domain filter
user.description: Every entity of the domain is published, or only those of the classes you pick next.

reconfigure.title: Edit domain filter
reconfigure.description: Every entity of the domain is published, or only those of the classes you pick next.

classes.title: Classes: {domain}
classes.description: Tick the classes that are published. With none ticked, the whole domain is.

error.domain_filter_exists: This domain already has a filter. Edit that row instead.

user.title: Add entity filter
user.description: Search for and add the entities that are published, whatever their domain.

reconfigure.title: Edit entity filter
reconfigure.description: Search for and add the entities that are published, whatever their domain.

user.title: Add exclusion
user.description: These entities are never published, even when a filter includes them. It holds in every mode and survives reinstalling the bridge.

reconfigure.title: Edit exclusion
reconfigure.description: These entities are never published, even when a filter includes them. It holds in every mode and survives reinstalling the bridge.
